payload.title: Accountant, Payroll & Billing Operations
payload.description:
Accountant, Payroll & Billing Operations 


Full-time, permanent | Operations | Reports to the Client Services Manager | Works closely with our Senior Accountant | Hybrid, Toronto, ON 

Salary: $65,000 – $75,000 per year, plus benefits and paid vacation. 


This posting is for an existing vacancy. We use artificial intelligence to help screen and assess applications. A person reviews every application, and people make every hiring decision. 


About Us 

Syndesus helps companies, mainly in the US, hire top AI, MLOps and data engineering talent in Canada. For companies without a Canadian entity, we act as the Employer of Record and take care of payroll, compliance, and HR so their teams can focus on the work. For companies that already have a Canadian entity, our Canada Co-pilot service works as their outsourced HR team. We’re based in Toronto and have been connecting Canadian talent with growing companies since 2014. 


About the role 

Syndesus is looking for an Accountant to join our operations team and own our payroll-to-billing cycle. We run multi-province payroll for about 130 employees on behalf of our clients, and our invoicing is driven by that payroll.  


Your main goal is to own the detail of our payroll-related general ledger and our employee-level client invoicing, accurately and on time, at the standard a business of our size needs. You’ll run monthly client invoicing in QuickBooks Online, reconciling payroll, billing and internal costs to ensure accuracy, and support month-end close and payroll compliance efforts.  


You’ll report to the Client Services Manager and work closely with our Senior Accountant, who reviews your work and approves invoice uploads. This role suits someone with 5-7 years of experience who likes to own their work, document what they do, and fix problems at the source rather than work around them.  

 

You'll review how we account for payroll and invoice clients, challenge unnecessary complexity, and put practical improvements in place. You will also guide a co-op student who helps with invoicing operations and process improvement.

payload.title: Founding Solution Engineer / Technical AI Lead (Europe)
payload.description:
About the company


Our client is a Google Cloud partner helping mid-to-large enterprises move from experimental AI to production-grade enterprise AI. We connect ERP systems, legacy platforms, internal databases and sources like SAP and Salesforce into Gemini Enterprise and GCP-native AI workflows, then layer agentic automation and governance on top.


We are a small, early-stage team based in Toronto, with an engineering team in India handling delivery. We are now building out our AI practice in Europe.


The role


You will be the technical lead for the company's AI work with European clients. This is a forward-deployed, high-ownership role: you run technical discovery with enterprise stakeholders, design the solution, and hand it off to our engineering team in India to deliver.


The role leans toward architecture, solutioning and client leadership, with hands-on engineering where it moves the work forward. You will also help shape how the practice grows in the region.


What you'll do

  • Lead technical discovery with enterprise clients, including CIO-level stakeholders, and translate business problems into AI solutions.
  • Design solution architecture for agentic AI on Google Cloud, integrating ERP, legacy and enterprise data sources.
  • Choose the right frameworks and approach for each engagement.
  • Write clear handoff specs and coordinate delivery with the India engineering team, owning quality from design to production.
  • Build prototypes and contribute hands-on code where it speeds up delivery.
  • Help build the company's European AI practice: repeatable patterns, client relationships and how we work.


What we're looking for


Technical skills</

payload.title: VP of Platform Engineering - Agentic AI (San Francisco)
payload.description:
VP of Platform Engineering


About this role

We are looking for a VP of Platform Engineering with 10+ years of experience to own and scale the AI-native platform core at a profitable, Series A agentic AI company serving hundreds of financial institutions. This is a player-coach role — you'll build and lead the platform engineering org while staying hands-on in the code, partnering directly with the CTO and CEO on architecture, product releases, and new initiatives.


What will you be doing?


  • Managing and growing the existing platform engineering team (~4 engineers today, expanding) while remaining deeply hands-on in code and architecture
  • Working directly with the CEO and CTO daily on product releases and new platform initiatives being built from scratch
  • Owning the AI-native platform core end-to-end — agent runtime, LLM orchestration, retrieval systems, evals, integrations, and the agent-authoring platform
  • Driving velocity, quality, and reliability across all platform domains including tooling, eval gates, and observability
  • Scaling the platform org and its engineering culture through the company's next stage of growth


Key Requirements


  • 10+ years of engineering experience with 4–6 years in leadership; must have scaling experience (revenue, funding stages, team growth)
  • Production-scale experience in AI/agentic systems, LLM/ML infrastructure, or conversational/voice AI — working on the platform side
  • Hands-on and still technical — must be actively coding, reviewing PRs, and making architecture calls (not a pure people manager)
  • Startup experience strongly preferred (Series A–D); open to strong VP-level candidates from big tech if they show exceptional career trajectory
  • Must be on-site in San Francisco 5 days/week; BS/BA in Computer Science required
  • 10 - 16 years of experience as a platform engineer
